# mistershell_fact_check (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell fact_check by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_fact_check" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

# Alternatively, resolve one exact name.
data "mistershell_fact_check" "by_name" {
  name = "fact-check"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `assertions` (Dynamic) Assertions.
- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `fact_type` (String) Fact type.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) Is builtin.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
